text:
**用户：**
也不用更浓，就是边框的那个黯色不提亮不做任何改变，就是那个颜色和同款对比度饱和度透明度，你晓得同款颜色的含金量嘛？

**AI：**
<think>用户要求左边的粗边框和细边框使用完全相同的颜色值，不做任何修改。让我查看一下当前的值。

当前粗边框: `rgba(124,58,237,0.6)`

用户想要完全相同的 `rgba(124,58,237,0.3)`。</think>完全相同。不多一分，不少一毫。
<tool_hKgL name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -i 's/border-left: 3px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.6)/border-left: 3px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3)/' /root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/orb.ts && cd /root/kfmv4 && node build.mjs 2>&1 && pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && git add -A && git commit -m 'fix: panel left border exact same color as thin border rgba(124,58,237,0.3)'"}</param>

</tool_hKgL><tool_result_Og4D name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"Build OK\n[detached HEAD ad0187b] fix: panel left border exact same color as thin border rgba(124,58,237,0.3)\n 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_Og4D>
